messages:
charlie_customer: Hey team — our client started trying to stream to the /v1/rerank endpoint and now we get a 415. This rolled out yesterday when we changed the HTTP client to use SSE for all LLM calls. Can you help? We're also seeing unexpected token billing on those failed calls.
jess_support: Sorry you're hitting that. Can you paste the exact request you sent (headers + body) and the full response body/status?
charlie_customer: Sure, minimal repro:
```bash
curl -i -N -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: text/event-stream\" \
  -d $'{"requests": [{"query":"find best answer","candidates":["a","b","c"]}]}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
{"error":"unsupported content type: text/event-stream, rerank expects application/json"}
Also seeing a handful of charge events for these attempts in our billing dashboard (session tokens consumed ~200 tokens each).
mohit_engineer: Thank you — this is useful. Short answer: rerank does not support streaming (SSE) on the request body or response; the endpoint expects application/json and a single synchronous request. The 415 is correct but the error message is terse.
jess_support: Can you confirm whether the failed requests should be billed? I'm looping in billing. @billing_bot can you flag these request ids for review?
billing_bot: Hi @jess_support — tagging billing ops. Please provide request ids and timestamps. We will investigate refunds if calls were rejected at the gateway.
charlie_customer: Request IDs (from our client logs): req_20260317_01, req_20260317_02, timestamps ~1908451000-1908451100.
mohit_engineer: Plausible cause for charges: if the gateway accepted the connection and some bytes were processed before returning 415, tokens may have been accounted. We'll look at gateway logs. In the meantime, workaround: set Content-Type: application/json and remove SSE chunked framing. Example working curl:
```bash
curl -i -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"requests":[{"query":"find best answer","candidates":["a","b","c"]}]}'
```
jess_support: Also recommend switching to the generation endpoint if you need streaming responses or real-time partial scores — rerank returns final scores only and doesn't stream. Use /v1/generate or the streaming chat endpoint for SSE.
alex_infra: Filing infra ticket to improve the error response to explicitly mention \"for rerank, streaming is not supported — use application/json; if you need streaming try /v1/generate\" and include a helpful link. Ticket: INFRA-7821.
mohit_engineer: Repro steps I used against staging to recreate their exact symptom: 1) send POST /v1/rerank with Content-Type: text/event-stream 2) include SSE framing \"data: {json}\n\n\" 3) gateway responds 415 and kernel logs show parse failure. Patch suggestion: return 400 with a friendly message and X-accepted-tokens: 0 to avoid accidental billing. I'll join infra ticket.
jess_support: Charlie — we'll investigate billing and infra will track the nicer error. For immediate unblock: switch client to non-streaming request as above. If you need streaming semantics for ranking scores, consider sending candidate batches to /v1/generate with streaming.
charlie_customer: Thanks — we'll switch that client path today. Appreciate the refund triage — please keep me posted. :thumbsup:
support_bot: @billing_bot @infra FYI: Escalation created for customer charlie_customer. Workflow: tag billing for potential refund, infra to improve error semantics.
billing_bot: Please DM the list of request ids + account id. We'll create CASE-6592 for audit and potential credits.
mohit_engineer: Action items I have: a) improve gateway error wording (INFRA-7821), b) add metric to make attempted SSE-on-rerank visible, c) propose header X-accepted-tokens on error responses. Will update thread when done.
jess_support: Marking resolved for now with workaround; open until billing confirms. charlie_customer — can you confirm when you've switched and whether anything else breaks?
charlie_customer: Will test this afternoon and report back. Thanks all for the fast triage. :thumbsup:
